programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.desc: After an unforeseen return, Dr. Carson Beckett shares that he has been held captive. As Teyla is re-united with some missing fellow Athosians, she begins to formulate a plan to ensure their escape, if she is able to find them in time.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: On a flight back to Atlantis, McKay inexplicably falls ill. Fearing the worst, the doctor summons McKay’s sister to say her goodbyes. But Ronan tells Jeannie of a shrine that would grant Rodney one day to be himself again, before he dies.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Disheartened by another unsuccessful search for Teyla, Lt. Colonel Sheppard returns to Atlantis and senses that something is not right—the city has been abandoned. Now, McKay sets out on a risky plan to reverse a future that went horribly wrong.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: As Sheppard and Ronon are trapped beneath a collapsed compound, McKay and Lorne are trapped in another pocket of debris. Michael’s flagship Wraith Cruiser hurtles towards the compound, while Carter leads a rescue mission. Who will reach them first?

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: When Dr. Keller fails to report for her shift, concerned team members are shocked to discover her unconscious in her quarters. With the situation on Atlantis escalating, Woolsey is ultimately faced with a decision that could cost Keller her life.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: During an off-world mission, Ronon (Jason Momoa) is ambushed and captured by his former friend, Tyre (Mark Dacascos), and turned over to the Wraith. As the team scrambles for leads to locate their friend, Ronon undergoes a torturous ordeal.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: A drive malfunction aboard a mysterious duplicate Daedalus sends the team jumping through various alternate realities where they encounter sinister alien life forms, a searing sun, and a pitched space battle over Atlantis.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: Using the communications stones, Lt. Scott and Camile Wray use their time back on Earth to visit those they’ve left behind. Aboard Destiny, the crew stumbles upon a piece of Ancient technology that carries the promise of a way home.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: Everyone is shocked when a member of the crew is found dead from a gunshot wound. While it appears to be suicide, the gun is nowhere to be found…until it shows up in Col. Young’s (Louis Ferreira) quarters and he becomes the number one suspect.

programme.title: Stargate Universe
programme.desc: An alien vessel appears in Destiny’s path and launches an attack, capturing Chloe. Col. Young must use the stones again to get aboard the ship and try to rescue Chloe. He quickly realizes, however, that Chloe isn’t the only prisoner aboard.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.desc: 'S25/E11 - Turkey-Giving'. Guy Fieri prepares for Turkey Day! In Princeton, NJ, rapper Rev. Run jumps in for crepes and a New Hampshire cafe cooks up terrific turkey meatloaf.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S25/E12 - Brunch, Bologna And Burgers'. Host Guy tries out fried bologna and veggie burgers in Louisville, KY, and brunch staples at a diner-restaurant mashup in Portland, OR.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S25/E13 - Carnivore Creations'. Guy visits some of the best carnivorous creations on the road, including a butchery in Portland, OR, and a cafe serving a killer steak sandwich in Hamilton, NJ.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E1 - Belly Up To Barcelona'. Guy Fieri crosses the Atlantic to take a bite out of Barcelona! He visits a homely spot serving Galician-style octopus and tries old-school Catalan food.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E2 - A Sampling Of Spain'. Guy Fieri is in Barcelona for a gastronomic feast! He tries out dishes from prawn and quail tapas, to traditional Catalan specialties including veal-head stew.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E3 - Mega Mouthfuls'. Guy Fieri unhinges his jaw for some mega-mouthful meals. In Louisville, KY, a seafood spot piles their specialities on top of waffles and he visits a BBQ food truck.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E4 - Swiss, Sandwiches And Sausage'. Guy Fieri stops in Portland, OR, and Charlotte, NC, to sample grilled cheese sandwiches with a twist, schnitzel, sausage and Swiss specialities.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E5 - Beef, Lamb And Pig'. Guy Fieri hunts down meaty favourites in Kentucky and North Carolina. He enjoys an Irish pub's cottage pie, Asian-barbecue fusion and pimento-topped burgers.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E6 - Kickin' It In Cancun'. Guy Fieri feels the heat in Mexico! He checks out a family-owned spot where grandma cooks up rellenos. And, Guy shows off his Playa Del Carmen restaurant.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S26/E7 - Not Your Typical Joints'. Guy checks out restaurants with funky dishes and unique specialties. They include an eatery tucked inside a beer store serving crazy waffle creations!

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S37/E15 - Meal Mashups'. The crew mashes up favourite meals into a gooey pasta bake, breakfast-ready fried rice, lasagna baked potatoes and a candy-coated cheese ball.

programme.title: Kids Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S5/E1 - #Selfieclairs'. A brand-new group of incredible kid bakers introduce themselves and get creative with selfie-inspired eclairs in a variety of assigned flavours.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Sue Ellen's Thanksgiving'. Host Casey Corn helps a woman complete her Thanksgiving table by recreating her mother's lost Cranberry Sauce and Custard Pie.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Grandma Taguhi's Armenian Lamb'. Host Casey Corn helps recreate a grandma's sweet and smoky Armenian-style lamb with adjar prepared using a traditional oven called a tonir.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E9 - Sarno's Pastiera Napoletana'. Casey Corn helps recreate an Italian family's Pastiera Napoletana recipe, a traditional Italian Easter tart made with sweet ricotta.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E10 - Felina's Chicken Adobo'. Host Casey Corn helps a woman unlock the delicious mysteries of her great-grandma Felina's tangy, salty, savoury and sweet chicken adobo.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Grandma Vernelle's Ambrosia'. Chef Casey Corn travels to Los Angeles to help a close-knit group of cousins recreate their grandma's lost ambrosia recipe.

programme.title: Recipe Lost And Found
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Grandma Lil's Meatball Sauce'. Casey visits a New York family to help them rediscover their Grandma Lil's unique, Jewish-Italian-American meatball sauce.

programme.title: Baking Championship: Next Gen
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - The Tryouts'. Hosts and judges Duff Goldman and Kardea Brown put 12 sibling teams through two rounds of skills challenges to assess which 10 teams will move on.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E6 - Pasta, Potatoes & Pescatarian'. Vanilla Ice takes Guy to his favourite Ecuadorian joint in West Palm Beach, Florida. Plus, Guy is in Minnesota to try scratch-made pasta and poutine.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E7 - Pig's Feet, Mojo And Chow-Chow'. Guy tastes seafood and chow-chow in Palm Beach, Florida. Later, he visits a funky Filipino joint in Hawaii to sample their spin on pig's feet.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E8 - Taste Of The Tropics'. Guy tucks into lobster enchiladas and lionfish rolls at a waterside restaurant in Florida. Plus, he chows down on Vietnamese sandwiches and spring rolls.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Athens'. Chef Andrew Zimmern explores classic Greek food. From stuffed vine leaves and spanakopita to moussaka, he discovers the traditional methods still used to make them.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Florence'. Florence, Italy lives up to its artistic reputation even in its food. Andrew explores classics like the rare Florentine steak, the original cappuccino and gelato.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S4/E1 - Brooklyn'. Andrew digs into Brooklyn's iconic eats. The multicultural borough offers old-school relics like juicy steak, perfect NY pizza, and Jewish pastries swirled with chocolate.

programme.title: Chopped Castaways
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Welcome To The Island'. Twelve chefs are split into teams on a remote island and must create three-course meals for the judges without traditional tools or electricity.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S56/E4 - Mouth Of The South'. Four chefs from the South aim to up their games against talented peers. First up, the appetiser basket includes a questionable take on fried chicken.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S37/E11 - Oh, The Pasta-bilities!'. Antonia Lofaso and comedian Jay Pharoah recruit pasta pros Sasha Grumman and Zach Chancey to bring the heat against Bobby Flay.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S37/E12 - Napa-ing On The Job'. Michael Symon and comedian Manon Mathews cheer on chefs Erin Miller and Stephen Coe, while Bobby Flay is greeted with a familiar face.

programme.title: Bobby Flay's The Line
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Leah Cohen: Pig & Khao'. Longtime 'Beat Bobby Flay' judge Leah Cohen challenges Bobby Flay's home team chefs to a Southeast Asian showdown.

programme.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - No Utensils Day'. The returning champ brings their $16,500 winnings to face chefs Maria Mazon and Brad Miller in a challenge to make only handheld food.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: 'S15/E2 - Sisters' Mexico Trip Kick-Off'. Molly Yeh jump-starts her sisters' trip to Mexico with breakfast tostadas, turkey tacos, an extra savoury salad and a cream float.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S5/E5 - Easter Delights'. The six remaining bakers have to create a brightly coloured marshmallow dessert and create a tropical fruit-flavoured dessert that looks like an Easter bonnet.

programme.title: Kitchen Crash
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Battle Of The Block'. In Harrington Park, NJ, a Battle of the Block Party becomes a cooking competition, with chefs making a triple-stacked sandwich and a 5-star meal!

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S6/E2 - Triple D Nation: Diner Dishes'. Guy Fieri digs in diner style with mighty mac 'n cheese in Atlanta, brisket hash in San Antonio and a supreme breakfast burrito in Scottsdale, AZ.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S6/E3 - Triple D Nation: Africa & Asia'. Guy Fieri heads back for a taste of Thailand in Boulder, CO, Pakistani favourites in Tempe, AZ, and Moroccan specialties in San Antonio.

programme.title: 24 In 24: Last Chef Standing
programme.desc: 'S3/E4 - Shift 4: Adaptability'. The nine remaining chefs face constant twists and turns, including missing kitchen equipment, while making a meal for judge Marcus Samuelsson.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: 'S16/E8 - Restaurants On The Rocks'. Robert Irvine helps a beloved restaurant on the brink of closing its doors in Ferguson, Missouri. The owners have run out of money and options!

programme.title: Buddy Vs. Duff
programme.desc: 'S3/E4 - First We Feast'. The teams create cake versions of food feasts. Duff's team makes a realistic farmers market while Buddy and his team create a towering monument of sweet treats.
